title: Reject incomplete CFGI symbols before auto-market sentiment source health can say PASS
objective: Fix ONLY existing auto_market_state source-health completeness classification. At Archive main 20fc2cca, assemble() sets health['sentiment'].status PASS for any truthy sentiment wrapper, including {'cfgi':{}}. Public original 2026-11-09 22:45 packet has source_health.sentiment.status PASS and normalized_state.sentiment.cfgi={}, while downstream Official Compass requires MARKET classification and MARKET/BTC/ETH numeric scores, generating FAIL_PASS_LANE_MISSING_VALUE. Distinguish missing required CFD/CFGI fields as UNAVAILABLE with a stable source-specific classification, without inventing values or weakening downstream fail-closed gates. Preserve valid 2026-11-13 packet status and contents. This repairs false source-health assertions, NOT underlying missing CFGI collection, chronic 61.64% source validity, time-lag, signal accuracy or production consumer delivery. Do not modify market direction, weights, alert severity or official trading authority. After code review/merge, verify genuinely issued next producer and Official / Pages source status separately.

evidence.summary: At assemble near source health sentiment: 'PASS' if sentiment else 'UNAVAILABLE' (a non-empty wrapper is truthy regardless of nested CFGI content).
Official 24-feature snapshot requires actual nested cfgi.symbols.MARKET classification + MARKET/BTC/ETH score; blank fields under upstream PASS become FAIL_PASS_LANE_MISSING_VALUE.
Observed frozen original public packet: source_health.sentiment = PASS, normalized_state.sentiment = {'cfgi':{}}; directly verifies false-health semantics for this incident.
Positive real public control: three MARKET/BTC/ETH symbols, finite numerical scores and MARKET classification all present, upstream sentiment PASS; valid input must retain PASS.
Original 2026-11-09 source-quality diagnosis and ownership contract; not a new authority or owner.

reproduction: Pin Archive main 20fc2ccabc75165257215d5c4ee255ecb55dac59. Read exact original public packet in evidence: 2026-11-09 normalized_state.sentiment.cfgi={} and source_health.sentiment.status='PASS'. From current scripts/data_ping/auto_market_state.py line near assemble, Python truthiness: bool({'cfgi':{}}) == True, hence PASS despite no cfgi.symbols. Independently read native_handlekompas.py evidence_snapshot, which maps MARKET classification and MARKET/BTC/ETH scores and marks missing value in PASS lane. Counterexample 2026-11-13 packet on same main has 3 complete symbols and PASS. Freeze original code/packet blob hashes above; do not silently rewrite them or claim all days failed. Implement deterministic negative/positive tests against actual helper and where practical an isolated auto-state assemble fixture. Only mark ready once source ownership/duplication/current code and the direct class mismatch are independently reproduced.

positive: A complete input with cfgi.symbols.MARKET/BTC/ETH Mapping objects and valid finite numeric scores, plus MARKET classification, retains health PASS and current normalized market values byte-compatible apart from source-health metadata.

An absent sentiment source remains UNAVAILABLE; a genuine valid original 2026-11-13 public shape remains source PASS; downstream Official consumes genuine values without an invented last-known fallback.

Run existing auto-market-state integrity suite with nonzero test count and exact-head native CI, plus a source→Official→public consumer observation AFTER qualifying merge before claiming production closure.
negative: Regression fixture {'cfgi':{}} fails PASS deterministically, classification MUST NOT say live sentiment complete. Also cases missing cfgi, no symbols, MARKET missing, BTC missing, ETH missing, missing/empty MARKET classification, nonfinite/string/bool scores, malformed containers, outer truthy unrelated sentiment keys.
Mutant that replaces completeness guard with prior `bool(sentiment)` must fail one or more of the negative tests. Regressions cannot be satisfied by mocking a source-health result alone.

Do not let absent CFGI be silently filled from stale previous packets, proxy sentiment, arbitrary 0, or private sources. No change to downstream native_handlekompas FAIL_PASS_LANE_MISSING_VALUE guard or source freshness policy.
No new workflow, provider call, schedule, secret, credentials, market thresholds, model weights, sell/buy action, historical rewrite or false production-success declaration.
